notes: Fiscal year 2025 ended January 31, 2026 (Rent the Runway's own label). Filings: Fiscal 2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001468327-26-000020, filed April 14, 2026) and the proxy for the July 14, 2026 annual meeting (accession 0001140361-26-023446), both read on www.sec.gov. ROSTER: On October 28, 2025 the company completed Recapitalization Transactions in which its lender, CHS US Investments LLC, exchanged debt for 26,175,193 new Class A shares and all Class B shares converted into Class A, leaving CHS with a controlling 59.7%. Jennifer Hyman resigned as Chief Executive Officer and President and from the Board effective May 15, 2026 (proxy); Teri Bariquit served as interim CEO, and Paige Thomas became CEO on September 14, 2026 (Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026). LEADER: the proxy, dated after her resignation, still lists Hyman with 250,159 Class A shares (including 6,155 held by her spouse and 103,047 RSUs vesting within 60 days of May 20, 2026), marked * (less than 1%), so pctEconomic is null; relation stays 'co-founder'. HOLDERS: the three lender-group holders are shown as printed (percent of Class A, the only class); the proxy gives only the Schedule 13D/A filing date (May 13, 2026), so asOf is null. The earlier holders (Bain Capital Ventures, Yisroel Mordechai Goldstone, Highland Capital) no longer appear in the 5% table. CASH: no dividends have ever been paid, and the financing section has no repurchase line (quoted), so buybacks are 0; the $12.5 million of stock issued and the $107.6 million non-cash change in common stock from the debt restructuring are issuance, not buybacks. STOCK COMP: $4.2 million, shown as 0.00 billion after rounding. GEOGRAPHY is null: the 10-K says 'All revenue is currently generated in the United States', so all revenue ($329.8 million) is U.S.
